name: useForm doesn't expose its leave-prompt guard — pages keep reinventing it for custom navigates
description:
useForm.ts's built-in leavePrompt guard is opaque: it's driven by an internal showLeavePrompt ref the page has no access to. Any page that needs to clear (or arm) that guard synchronously around a custom navigate — a mixed-outcome redirect, a publish handoff, anything that isn't a plain successful submit — has to disable it entirely (leavePrompt: false) and hand-roll its own ref + useLeavePrompt call instead.

**Two pages have already, independently, reinvented this exact workaround:**

- `admin/react/src/Core/pages/PartnerServiceAdd/components/useMixedOutcomeRedirect.ts` — owns its own ref to follow a mixed-outcome save's redirect and clear the guard synchronously before useForm's own success handler runs. Needed an extra bug-fix round mid-review to get the success-path clear wired correctly too (see PR).
- `admin/react/src/AiRnd/pages/CopyWriterDetail/CopyWriterDetailEdit.tsx` — its own comment: "Mirrors useForm's built-in leave prompt (disabled above) because the publish handoff must clear the guard synchronously before navigate(), and useForm does not expose its internal prompt ref."

Same root cause, same hand-rolled shape, each implementation has to independently get the synchronous-clear-before-navigate timing right — a subtle detail that's easy to get wrong even once, let alone twice. Worth a shared primitive (e.g. useForm returning/accepting a controllable guard ref, or an onSuccess/onError wrapper that exposes the clear) before a third page copies the pattern.

_Not urgent — no known live bug from the duplication today. This is a maintainability/DRY flag for whenever useForm.ts next gets touched, or for the next page that needs this pattern._
